name: composition_grid
retail_role: 5 pitch rows x 24 one-second steps; int32 cells -1 empty, 0..9 machine start, 10 continuation

name: activity_state
retail_role: Bob's Band internal state 0..10; 8 prepare playback, 9 playing, 10 exit to Play Again

name: playback_start_counter_low
retail_role: Captured performance-counter start value used by playback timing

name: previous_elapsed_centiseconds
retail_role: State 8 initializes to 999999 so second 0 triggers immediately; state 9 stores latest elapsed centiseconds

name: conductor_animation_tick
retail_role: Increments every playback update; frame advances when tick >3 then tick resets to zero

name: conductor_animation_frame
retail_role: Playback conductor sprite frame; retail ranges all begin at 50

name: shared_completion_code
retail_role: State 8 writes 6; quit/leave later uses non--1 value to route through shared movie state 0x40

name: conductor_progress
retail_role: Writes 1 when state 8 prepares playback; player progress slots 52..54

name: machine_span_table
retail_role: Ten int32 values 1,2,1,2,1,2,1,2,1,2 for machine types 0..9
Farmer Pickles conductor playback animation frames

name: 0x3C
retail_role: Play Again Yes/No after PreparePlayAgainTransition and save/unload

name: 0x2A
retail_role: Music chooser when leave request is accepted and shared completion code is -1

name: 0x40
retail_role: Overrides leave/quit route whenever shared completion code is active

name: 0x2E
retail_role: Retail navigation/context value written during state-10 Play Again exit
